title: Building Palette
description: Alt-scroll between building shapes, conserve material, and combine slabs, steps, and corners in one block space.

gallery.title: Half-block details with mixed materials
gallery.description: Slabs, explicit stairs, quarter-volume steps, and eighth-volume corners, including oak and stone within one block space.

gallery.title: Hotbar shape scroll
gallery.description: A looping vertical shape strip rises from the active hotbar slot. Alt-scroll changes the shape while retaining the material balance in that slot.

gallery.title: One slot, conserved material
gallery.description: 512 corners, 128 slabs, or 85 stairs plus a stored remainder each represent 64 full blocks of material.

gallery.title: Scroll shapes in either direction
gallery.description: Hold Alt over an inventory stack to see nearby shapes above and below the selected slot, using the same shape order as the hotbar.

gallery.title: Terrain lighting with Photon
gallery.description: Combined oak and stone pieces rendered with Sodium, Iris, and Photon, receiving terrain lighting, ambient occlusion, and shadows.

gallery.title: Native and combined material lighting
gallery.description: Touching native quartz/blackstone vertical slabs on the left and the same materials combined in one grid block on the right, under equal overhead light.
